import Cache.Hashing
open Lean Cache IO Hashing
def main : IO Unit := CacheM.run do
  let sp := (← read).srcSearchPath
  let file ← Lean.findLean sp `Mathlib
  let memo ← getHashMemo (({} : Std.HashMap Name System.FilePath).insert `Mathlib file)
  for (name, hash) in memo.hashMap.toList do
    IO.println s!"{name} {hash.asLTar}"
module_order: Sort the distinct Mathlib module names from the unchanged external snapshot lexicographically. Encode the corresponding official cache key as 8 bytes from its 16 hex digits.
